records.title: FactorLLM: Factorizing Knowledge via Mixture of Experts for Large Language Models
records.reason: FactorLLM decomposes dense LLM FFNs into sparse expert subnetworks and its primary abstract reports more than 30% inference-speed improvement.

records.title: Equilibrium Language Models
records.reason: Equilibrium Language Models replace groups of Transformer layers, add a one-step KV cache, and explicitly target memory-limited edge deployment.

records.title: CQS-Attention: Scaling Up the Standard Attention Computation for Infinitely Long Sequences
records.reason: The IEEE DOI/title and abstract were located in a secondary full-text mirror, but DOI resolution and targeted IEEE Xplore retrieval did not expose the publisher abstract; primary evidence is insufficient to classify.

records.title: An Empirical Study on Latency Reduction Techniques for Large Language Models
records.reason: The DOI and conference metadata identify an LLM latency-reduction study, but the official IEEE abstract could not be retrieved after DOI/IEEE search attempts; title alone cannot establish the techniques or results.

records.title: Theoretical Foundation of Flow-Based Time Series Generation: Provable Approximation, Generalization, and Efficiency
records.reason: The primary abstract studies approximation/generalization of flow-based time-series generation; its efficiency claim concerns sampling theory for an unrelated application.

records.title: Resource-Efficient LLM Customization on Mobile Devices Through Proxy Submodel Tuning
records.reason: Publisher registration and bibliographic metadata support the IEEE DOI and title; the DOI/IEEE primary abstract remained inaccessible. The subject is on-device LLM customization/tuning, with no verified inference-serving efficiency result.

records.title: Subkv: Quantizing Long Context KV Cache for Sub-Billion Parameter Language Models on Edge Devices
records.reason: SubKV uses key/channel and value/token quantization plus dynamic-window handling to reduce KV-cache size for long-context inference on edge devices.

records.title: FlexQ: Efficient Post-training INT6 Quantization for LLM Serving via Algorithm-System Co-Design
records.reason: FlexQ combines post-training INT6 quantization with specialized GPU kernels for LLM serving; its abstract reports end-to-end inference acceleration and memory savings.

records.title: Block-Sparse Global Attention for Efficient Multi-View Geometry Transformers
records.reason: The primary abstract accelerates global attention in multi-view geometry reconstruction, a standalone computer-vision application rather than LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Efficient Large Language Models with Zero-Shot Adjustable Acceleration
records.reason: The primary abstract presents zero-shot-adjustable LLM inference acceleration, dynamically changing hardware usage after fine-tuning without further training.

records.title: Exact Causal Attention with 10% Fewer Operations
records.reason: Fast Causal Attention algebraically reduces operations in exact causal attention and reports GPU speedups over PyTorch and Triton baselines.

records.title: Harmonia: End-to-End RAG Serving Optimization
records.reason: Harmonia is an end-to-end RAG serving framework with heterogeneous deployment and a load-aware runtime controller; its abstract reports throughput and SLO improvements.

records.title: Scalable and Fast Inference Serving via Hybrid Communication Scheduling on Heterogeneous Networks
records.reason: HeroServe jointly schedules computation and network communication in LLM inference serving over heterogeneous networks and reports improved scalability and latency.

records.title: TuneComp: Joint Fine-tuning and Compression for Large Foundation Models
records.reason: TuneComp jointly fine-tunes and compresses large foundation models into a smaller pruned low-rank structure; compression directly reduces deployed model size.

records.title: HeadQ: Model-Visible Distortion and Score-Space Correction for KV-Cache Quantization
records.reason: The primary abstract proposes score-space KV-cache quantization with a learned correction code; although it focuses on fidelity rather than measured speed, it directly targets cache representation cost.

records.title: OPSERVE: Opportunistic LLM Inference over Fragmented GPU Capacity in HPC Systems
records.reason: The official SC26 program describes opportunistic LLM inference using transient/persistent workers and shared KV state to exploit fragmented HPC GPU capacity.

records.title: State-space models can learn in-context by gradient descent
records.reason: The primary abstract studies how an SSM can implement in-context gradient descent, not serving efficiency. Recurrent-state architecture has a plausible efficiency connection, but no systems benefit is measured.

records.title: Libra: Novel LLM Token Streaming via Region-Based Task Scheduling and Token Bundling
records.reason: The IEEE DOI and conference metadata identify a token-streaming scheduler, but the publisher abstract could not be retrieved after DOI resolution and targeted IEEE search; no mechanism/result is asserted from title alone.

records.title: System 2 Reasoning Capabilities Are Nigh
records.reason: The primary abstract is a survey of reasoning capabilities and does not propose or measure an inference-system efficiency mechanism.

records.title: PLaMo 2 Technical Report
records.reason: PLaMo 2’s primary technical report describes structured pruning, weight reuse, vLLM and quantization for an efficient LLM deployment.
